items.description: Creation editor one-line fields become one-row textareas for iPad Tab: Recipe name and Version name (CreationPage.jsx 657, 690), a step's target label and value (CreationSteps.jsx 123, 133), a scale's and a problem's Name, Low end, High end (CreationSetup.jsx 47), each style target's low and high end (CreationSetup.jsx 202, 213), the picker's Name filter (IngredientPicker.jsx 60), and Serving temperature (CreationSetup.jsx 176) as a one-row textarea with inputMode decimal whose 84 px width rule .notebook .mk-field-row .ink-field[type='number'] moves to a class; findRefusedField in CreationPage.jsx and CreationSetup.jsx line 78 move to the textarea. Spec: .impeccable/proposals/2026-11-01-one-line-fields.md sections 2 to 5 and DESIGN.md Fields "One-line field" (Mark chose serving-only on decide-one-line-fields, 2026-11-01); pattern quick 261101-lec (app/src/ui/oneLineField.js holdReturn and stripNewlines, tokens-only CSS); apply the five CSS duties that touch these fields; keep every attribute (inputMode, autoCapitalize, autoComplete, spellCheck, enterKeyHint, required, placeholder, autoFocus, refs, onBlur); move every selector and test that finds these fields by tag; prove the fields against a scratch build of the base in Playwright WebKit and Chrome at 1366 fine and coarse (box, ink, neighbours, focus ring, Return, paste, long text), Sid probe .impeccable/proposals/2026-11-01-one-line-fields-probe.mjs as a start; run the full suite; never build into app/dist, no vite servers.
